head: 此
target: de ltar rigs kyi bu 'di ni de lta bu'i yon tan dam pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / mthu dang / gzi brjid kyi shugs dang / shin tu brtson pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis skad cig thang cig tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med grangs med par phyin cing /
